title: Python Tkinter Calculator
summary: A desktop calculator built with Python and Tkinter to practice GUI development and event handling.
description: A desktop calculator built with Python and Tkinter to practice GUI development, event handling, input validation, and calculator operations.
problem: Wanted hands-on practice with Python GUI development, event-driven programming and input validation beyond command-line scripts.
solution: Built a Tkinter-based calculator GUI that handles arithmetic operations, decimal input, resetting, expression evaluation and error cases such as division by zero.

title: Singly Linked List in C
summary: A menu-driven implementation of a singly linked list in C, practicing pointers and dynamic memory management.
description: A menu-driven implementation of a singly linked list in C created to practice linked-list operations, pointers, and dynamic memory management.
problem: Wanted structured practice with pointers and manual memory management in C through a concrete data structure.
solution: Implemented a menu-driven singly linked list program covering standard list operations using dynamically allocated memory.

title: Stack Operations in C
summary: A menu-driven stack implementation in C using dynamically allocated memory.
description: A menu-driven stack implementation in C using dynamically allocated memory.

title: Queue Operations in C
summary: A menu-driven queue implementation in C using dynamically allocated memory.
description: A menu-driven queue implementation in C using dynamically allocated memory.
features: Resets front/rear when the final element is removed

title: Student Registration Form
summary: A responsive student registration form interface built with HTML and CSS.
description: A responsive student registration form interface created with HTML and CSS to practice form structure, layout, styling, spacing, and input design. This is a frontend-only interface — it does not include database integration, backend processing, stored submissions or authentication.

title: Number Game in Python
summary: A turn-based number game built in Python to practice programming logic and game-flow control.
description: A turn-based number game created in Python to practice programming logic, loops, conditions, user input, and basic game-flow control. The player and program select numbers within the game's allowed range while progressing toward a target value.
